Not much happening at Malouf

Mar 09 2014

Flint Gullick

Fry

Member Since :
2014
Number of Posts :
43

Temperature in the high 30s this morning when we started.  Fishing was slow, with one of my buddies catching two bass, the largest being about 18” and 3.5 lbs.  The other two of us were skunked.  Once the wind came up we moved to the dam end of the lake and fished the calmer water, but caught no additional fish.  No sign of bedding activity in the shallows. 

Water temperature was about 49* when we started and about 51* when we came off the water.  Water levels are good; maybe down about 4’ but the ramp is still touching the water.  The club boat has been patched and is back in place.  It took on about 1/2” of water in the 3.5+ hours we were on the lake.

Posted By: Flint Gullick
